Automatic Execution Paths

No evidence was provided for malicious execution during installation or Python interpreter startup.

  • The provided PKG-INFO contains metadata, dependencies, and documentation, but no evidence of .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, malicious setup.py, PEP 517 build hooks, or import-time side effects.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Obfuscation

  • **Credential harvesting:** No evidence found. Single documented service credential environment-variable usage is consistent with normal SDK/adapter behavior.
  • **Archive staging / exfiltration:** No evidence found. Network requests appear tied to explicit HTTP/LLM/GitHub/Telegram/Solana adapters or examples/tests; no file harvesting, archive staging, or upload to attacker-controlled endpoints was identified.
  • **Persistence:** No malicious evidence found. .bashrc/.zshrc PATH updates and cron references are in user-invoked host installation/integration or documentation/test contexts.
  • **Kubernetes/CI/cloud lateral movement:** No evidence found. GitHub Actions/GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_PAT mentions describe public Markdown sync documentation, with no token theft or workflow injection evidence.
  • **Obfuscation / staged loader:** No evidence found. base64.b64decode appears related to email attachment handling; no eval/exec obfuscated loader, encrypted payload, or self-deleting dropper evidence was identified.
